==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|publish|-er<id:agent noun>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpʌblɪʃɚ/|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-publisher.ogg|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A person or (especially) a company who [[publish]]es, especially books.
#: {{syn|en|publishing house<qq:company>|;|q2=[[elide#Verb|elided]] forms|pubber|pub#Etymology_5}}
#: {{hyper|en|house<id:place of business, company, organization>}}
#* {{RQ:Wodehouse My Man Jeeves|passage=All a '''publisher''' has to do is write [[cheque]]s at intervals, while a lot of deserving and industrious [[chappy|chappies]] rally round and do the real work.}}
# {{lb|en|programming}} A system or component that allows other components ([[subscriber]]s) to receive [[notification]]s of something, such as an [[event]].
# {{lb|en|Christianity}} A [[preacher]] who is a [[Jehovah's Witness]].
